product.name: Tarnvale 5000 Portable Power Station (TV5K-5190)
product.description: Portable 5.12 kWh LiFePO4 power station for home backup and off-grid use. 5000 W continuous output, 10-year warranty, EU Battery Regulation compliant.

manufacturer.name: Family Labs Energy Systems GmbH
manufacturer.singleContactPoint: Product compliance desk, Family Labs Energy Systems GmbH, Turmstrasse 30, 10551 Berlin, Germany

data.manufacturingPlace: Brandenburg an der Havel, Germany (FLE Werk 2)

idleTemperature.referenceTest: Manufacturer storage test TS-TV5K-07: 30 days at each limit, 50 % state of charge

expectedLifetime.referenceTest: EN IEC 62620 cycle endurance test, 0.5C charge and discharge at 25 °C, end of life at 70 % of rated capacity

batteryModel.product: Tarnvale 5000 Portable Power Station, model TV5K-2026

certificates: Kestrel Conformity Services GmbH, technical documentation review TDR-TV5K-2026-014, issued 2026-02-24, valid until 2029-02-23

objectOfDeclaration.value: Tarnvale 5000 Portable Power Station, model TV5K-2026: rechargeable lithium iron phosphate industrial battery, 5.12 kWh, 51.2 V nominal, with integrated inverter and charger.

additionalInformation.value: The integrated inverter and charger are covered by this same declaration.

declarationOfConformity.notifiedBodyIntervention: Voluntary third-party review of the technical documentation and of the Article 12 safety test reports at the manufacturer's request. The conformity assessment itself followed Module A, internal production control.
standardsAndSpecifications: UN Manual of Tests and Criteria, Part III, sub-section 38.3
declarationOfConformity.soleResponsibilityStatement: This declaration of conformity is issued under the sole responsibility of the manufacturer.

substanceImpacts.value: The electrolyte contains a fluorinated lithium salt and flammable organic solvents. If released they can form toxic and corrosive gases and contaminate soil and water, which is why the battery must be collected separately and treated.

meaningOfLabelsAndSymbols.value: Crossed-out wheeled bin: collect separately, never in household waste. CE: the manufacturer declares conformity with applicable EU legislation. QR code: links to this product information.

endUserRoleInWastePrevention.value: Use and store the unit within the stated temperature range and keep it charged between uses to extend its life. Have faults repaired rather than replacing the unit.

collectionAndTreatmentAvailable.value: Free take-back at the point of sale and through the manufacturer's own take-back service (request at https://support.tarnvale.example/tv5k/return). Returned units are checked for repair or repurposing first; units that cannot be reused are sent for recycling.

endUserRoleInSeparateCollection.value: Do not dispose of this battery with household waste. Hand it in for separate collection free of charge.

wasteBatteryHandlingSafetyInstructions.value: Switch the unit off and discharge it below 30 % before transport. Do not open, puncture or crush the battery module. Keep a damaged unit outdoors, away from combustible material, and contact the take-back service.
